channel.title: Awesome WorkBuddy updates
channel.description: Newly curated WorkBuddy resources, audits, and directory improvements.

item.title: New Skills and Agent Suite added
item.description: Added the MIT-licensed BadWeWrite and Poetry Resonance Skills plus the Public Agent Suite, with bilingual descriptions and usage boundaries.

item.title: README made easier for everyday users
item.description: Reorganized the bilingual README around user goals, quick entry points, practical search terms, and a first-task example.

item.title: Cleaner bilingual catalog and easier resource submissions
item.description: Removed duplicate resource entries, added bilingual catalog parity checks, refreshed the discovery queue, and linked a direct community resource submission path.

item.title: v0.10.11: CodeBuddy integrations and audit hardening
item.description: Added four curated CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy resources, documented safety boundaries, normalized historical audit Issues, and hardened automatic audit labeling.

item.title: v0.10.9: TencentDB Agent Memory
item.description: Added TencentDB Agent Memory and documented WorkBuddy Proxy, credential, port, retention, and team-sharing boundaries.

item.title: Four new WorkBuddy integrations curated
item.description: OpenMAIC, memU, AgentsView, and TencentDB Agent Memory are now highlighted in the bilingual directory with safety notes.
